text:
lee: Quick check — marketplace launch this Thu. Major outstanding items: partner tile art, press embargo time, SI integration runbook, and translation windows. Throw up blockers now.

toni: Tile art incoming from Partner X but formats include SVG and WebP. Can frontend accept both? Need to confirm max file size.

vasco: Frontend accepts WebP and PNG. Max 200KB. If Partner X gives SVG we’ll rasterize to meet the limit.

rachel: For press/legal  legal wants 36-hour embargo notice. Marketing prefers publish at 03:00 UTC Thursday so APAC can pick up same day. Any objections?

peter: 03:00 UTC Thu works for me. That still gives partners a Monday preview window. @pressbot can you prepare the embargo email schedule?

pressbot: Embargo schedule drafted. Distribution: press@redwood-inference.com + targeted tech beat list. Press kit URL: https://cdn.redwood/marketplace/presskit_v2.zip. Embargo set to 2026-04-16T03:00:00Z pending legal thumbs-up.

lee: Great. SI runbook status? We need step-by-step for partner integrators: provision, mapping SKU -> model, entitlements, retry policy.

toni: Draft runbook in GH repo: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-runbooks/tree/si. Contains curl samples and mapping table. Still missing service mapping for hardware partners (GPU SKU names).

vasco: I pushed a hardware SKU mapping for common clouds to the same repo. Example mapping: redwood.gpu.x1 -> GCP A2, aws.gpu.mellon -> p4d-small. It's fuzzy for some partners, will tidy up by EOD.

rachel: Landing page copy  localization note: avoid slang so translations are short-form. Localization team needs final copy by Tuesday 16:00 UTC to hit the translation pipeline.

peter: We'll lock hero copy by Tuesday 12:00 UTC. Also, marketing needs a partner quote and a 1-line blurb from hardware partners about performance. Can @lee coordinate quotes?

lee: Reaching out to Partner X and Y now. Expect one-liners by tomorrow.

toni: Analytics: propose UTM pattern utm_source=marketplace_partner&utm_medium=tile&utm_campaign=apr16_launch. Also tag partner id as utm_content=<partner_id>. Anyone object?

vasco: Fine. We'll have the redirect service inject UTM parameters server-side so individual partner tiles don't need manual edits.

lee: Onboard flow question: do partners get a sandbox tenant automatically or is it via the claim endpoint? We must document this in runbook.

peter: Sandbox provisioning is automated when partner signs the agreement but claim link exists for manual issuance. I'll add both flows to the runbook.

rachel: Press logistics  after embargo lifts: 1) publish blog, 2) update landing page, 3) email partners, 4) ping partners' PMs with claim link. Marketing will coordinate translations for social posts 2 hours post publish.

toni: CDN cache TTLs? Need short TTL for tiles during launch to avoid stale images. Suggest 5 minutes for hero assets for first 6 hours.

vasco: Set CDN purge and TTL accordingly. I'll make an infra PR to apply 5m TTL for /marketplace/hero/* for launch window.

lee: Hotline coverage during T+0..T+8? Who is primary? We need SI-facing Zoom and a quick escalation ladder.

opsbot: Rota set: Week-of-launch primary @toni, secondary @vasco, tertiary @peter. SI Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/marketplace-si. Pager duty escalation to infra-oncall. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/marketplace-si-runbook.

rachel: Notification templates  can someone draft partner-facing launch email that includes claim link, support Zoom, and recommended verification steps? Keep it short and include contact points.

peter: I'll draft and post a template in the marketing folder. Will include verification checklist: 1) tile visible, 2) claim link works, 3) entitlement shows active, 4) sample API call succeeds.

lee: Testing note  QA found a mismatch: partner tile click-through currently points to checkout path for direct buys. Should point to partner detail catalog page. Toni can you patch?

toni: Fixing redirect now. Will deploy to staging tag stg-mp-20260414 and ask QA to verify.

vasco: Also fixed webhook retries to 72 hours for increased reliability. Updated docs with example curl to poll webhook backlog.

lee: Final recap (short):
- @toni: patch redirect, confirm file formats and CDN TTLs (today)
- @vasco: finish hardware SKU tidy, set CDN TTL PR, webhook retry docs (EOD)
- @peter: draft partner email template, document sandbox flows (tomorrow AM)
- @pressbot: finalize embargo distribution when legal confirms (today)
- @opsbot: standby rota and runbook links live

lee: If everyone posts a quick thumbs-up I'll mark this green. :thumbsup:

toni: 44d

vasco: 44d

peter: 44d

pressbot: Embargo assets ready, standing by. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: Oncall set, Zoom ready. :phone:

lee: Closing thread. Any late blockers, open #launch-alerts.
